svg.title: MacinDecode AC-4 Player — head tracking
svg.desc: The listener turns from side to side. A scene-relative object stays where it is in the room, and the arc from the listener's facing direction to it opens and closes — the bearing you hear changes, which is what head tracking sounds like. A head-locked object swings around the room with the head, and its arc keeps exactly the same angle — the bearing you hear never changes, so it sounds fixed while only the picture moves. Reduced-motion preferences show the head facing forward.

g.text: its arc opens and closes: the bearing you hear changes
its arc is rigid: the bearing you hear never changes
The one that moves on screen is the one that does not move in your ears
Reduced motion shows the head forward
